<!-- pr-reviewer: d395f1a61783cd3ee8e21ec2063314f1498ae656 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Save path is safe: `store::save_text` validates first (`store.rs` save_text), then `write_atomic` writes a temp file in the same folder, `sync_all`, rename, and removes the temp on error. IO errors come back as `SaveError::Io` with the OS text.
- No path traversal: `file_in` refuses empty names, `/`, `\`, `:` and leading `.`, so a save lands only in the user folder.
- Shipped machines are never overwritten by Save: built-ins and files under `assets/machines` open read-only, and `save()` returns `NeedsSaveAs` (`draft.rs` 49-55, 179-185). Save As asks before replacing an existing file.
- A machine that fails the #382 validator is refused in both `save` and `save_as` and is never written. Unknown keys survive the edit.
- File IO is in the app layer (`machine::store`); the UI only draws and calls it. The pane edits a file, not document state, and queues no command (the PR says so and the UI header says so). Nothing mounted on a setup is touched, so no undo or stale-op handling is owed here (#384 covers assignment).
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in the new non-test code. Provenance lines are present. No snapshot PNG, build.rs, scripts, .github or Cargo changes. Decision file is present. The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends `Fixes #383`.

**Local results (merged with main, clean merge, no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-app --test machine` | 32 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test machine_edit` | 12 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test machine_library` | 11 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib -- machines_pane machines_edit machine_file_editor` (CWD crates/ui) | 8 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- `is_shipped_path` (`draft.rs:51`) only matches a parent folder named `assets/machines`. If `CAMCRAFT_MACHINES` points at the shipped folder, or an install lays the library out differently, a file there would count as user-owned. An explicit path override makes this unlikely.
- A machine already mounted on a setup is not refreshed when its source file is saved. That is fine for this slice; #384 should define the reload through an undoable command.
- `validate.rs` is 376 lines and `fields.rs` is 329. Both are under the limit but near it.
- This is a feat, so it merges at the cut.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
